en.headline: Palace Museum exhibition on Qing court workshops stays open
en.dek: The Hong Kong Palace Museum opened a show on the imperial workshops of the Qing court on 30 September, and it remains on view in Gallery 5 over the holiday weekend.
body: A joint exhibition on the design work of the Qing court's imperial workshops remains open at the Hong Kong Palace Museum through the National Day holiday weekend.

The West Kowloon Cultural District Authority said the show, Design for the Forbidden City: Imperial Workshops of the Qing Court, is presented with the Palace Museum in Beijing. It opened to the public on 30 September in Gallery 5.

The authority described the exhibition as a look at traditional aesthetics through the objects and design practice of the imperial workshops. It did not, in the opening announcement, set a closing date.
The museum is in the West Kowloon Cultural District. Visitors should check the museum's own notices for current opening hours over the remainder of the holiday.

zh.headline: 故宮文化博物館清代造辦處設計展假期繼續開放
zh.dek: 香港故宮文化博物館與北京故宮博物院合辦的造辦處設計展，9月30日於5號展廳開放，國慶假期周末仍在展出。
body: 香港故宮文化博物館一個關於清代宮廷造辦處設計的展覽，國慶假期周末仍然開放。
西九文化區管理局表示，展覽名為「為紫禁城而設計：清代宮廷造辦處」，由香港故宮文化博物館與故宮博物院合辦，9月30日起於5號展廳公開展出。
管理局指，展覽從造辦處的器物與設計實踐，看傳統美學如何延續。開幕公布並未列出結束日期。
博物館位於西九文化區。假期餘下日子的開放時間，以館方最新告示為準。
